# Brevard Coastal Homes

> Real estate search site for Brevard County, Florida (the Space Coast) — browse homes, condos, and land for sale, updated continuously from the MLS.

## About

- Brevard Coastal Homes is a real estate listing and search site covering Brevard County, FL, including barrier-island beach cities and mainland communities.
- Listings are sourced from the MLS and refresh continuously (price, status, and photos).
- The site is organized by city, by neighborhood, and by individual listing, with Area Guide pages providing local context (amenities, schools, HOA fees) and FAQs for many neighborhoods.

## Cities covered

- [Cocoa Beach](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/cocoa-beach)
- [Indialantic](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/indialantic)
- [Indian Harbour Beach](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/indian-harbour-beach)
- [Melbourne](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/melbourne)
- [Melbourne Beach](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/melbourne-beach)
- [Merritt Island](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/merritt-island)
- [Rockledge](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/rockledge)
- [Satellite Beach](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/satellite-beach)
- [Viera](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/viera)
- [Viera West](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/viera-west)

## Page types

- City listings, all types combined (`/{city}`): e.g. [Cocoa Beach](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/cocoa-beach)
- City listings by type (`/{city}/homes-for-sale`, `/{city}/condos-for-sale`, `/{city}/land-for-sale`): e.g. [Cocoa Beach homes for sale](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/cocoa-beach/homes-for-sale)
- Oceanfront listings, barrier-island cities only (`/{city}/oceanfront-homes-for-sale`, `/{city}/oceanfront-condos-for-sale`, `/{city}/oceanfront-listings`): e.g. [Cocoa Beach oceanfront homes for sale](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/cocoa-beach/oceanfront-homes-for-sale)
- Neighborhood listings (`/neighborhoods/{slug}`): e.g. [Adelaide](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/neighborhoods/adelaide)
- Neighborhood Area Guides, amenities/schools/HOA/FAQ (`/neighborhoods/{slug}/area-guide`): e.g. [Adelaide Area Guide](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/neighborhoods/adelaide/area-guide)
- Individual listing detail pages: `/listings/{id}` (ids change continuously as the MLS feed updates, so no example link is listed here)
- [Sell your home](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/looking-to-sell)
- [Contact](https://brevardcoastalhomes.com/contact)
